name: Acoustic guitar with hard case
description: Full-size dreadnought acoustic with a solid spruce top and a warm, balanced tone. Set up with light strings and a low action. Includes a hard case, capo and spare strings. A few honest marks.

name: Electric guitar and practice amp
description: Solid-body electric guitar with a 15W practice amp, a cable and a gig bag. Great for learning chords, recording riffs or playing at a small gathering. Action is comfortable and frets are clean.

name: 88-key digital piano
description: Full-size 88-key digital piano with weighted keys, built-in speakers and a sustain pedal. Headphone output for quiet practice. Includes a stand and a bench. The keys are all responsive.

name: 40W guitar amplifier
description: Forty-watt combo amp with clean and overdrive channels, reverb and a headphone out. Loud enough for a small venue, quiet enough for a bedroom. The speaker has no tears.

name: 12-channel audio mixer
description: Twelve-channel mixer with four mic preamps, two stereo line channels and built-in effects. Perfect for a small gig, a podcast or a school event. Includes a power supply and a manual.

name: DJ controller, 2-channel
description: Two-channel DJ controller with jog wheels, hot cues and a built-in sound card. Connects by USB to a laptop and works with the main DJ software. Includes a carry case and cables.

name: Wireless microphone, pair
description: Two handheld wireless microphones with a receiver, about 50m of range and 8 hours per battery pair. Clear for speeches, karaoke and small events. Includes XLR and jack cables.

name: Powered PA speaker, 12-inch
description: Twelve-inch powered speaker with 400W of output and two mic inputs. Stands on a pole or sits on a table. Good for a party, a market stall or a garden ceremony. Includes a power cable.

name: DSLR camera with 18-55mm lens
description: Entry-level DSLR with an 18-55mm zoom, a spare battery and a 32GB card. Great for portraits, holidays and product photos. The sensor was cleaned recently and the shutter count is low.

name: Mirrorless camera, body only
description: Mirrorless body with a 24MP sensor, 4K video and two spare batteries. Takes the same lens mount as the telephoto in my other listing, so you can borrow both for one trip.

name: 70-200mm telephoto lens
description: Weather-sealed 70-200mm f/2.8 zoom for sport, wildlife and portraits with soft backgrounds. Sharp wide open and the stabiliser works. Includes hood, caps and a padded bag.

name: Carbon fibre tripod
description: Four-section carbon tripod with a ball head and a quick-release plate. Reaches 1.6m and folds to 45cm. Holds a full-frame camera and a heavy lens steadily. Light enough to carry all day.

name: Ring light with stand
description: Eighteen-inch ring light with a 2m stand, phone holder and a bag. Gives even, warm light for portraits, video calls and product shots. Three colour temperatures and ten brightness levels.

name: 3-axis gimbal stabiliser
description: Handheld three-axis gimbal for a phone or a small camera. Makes walking shots and panning video smooth. The motors calibrate in seconds and last about 12 hours. Includes a mini tripod.

name: Instant camera with film
description: Instant film camera with a built-in flash and selfie mirror. Comes with two packs of film (16 shots). Great for weddings, parties and scrapbooks. The film is in date and stored cool.

name: Photo backdrop and stand kit
description: Two-by-three-metre backdrop stand with a white and a grey cloth, plus clips and sandbags. Sets up in ten minutes for portraits, product photos or a party photo booth. Everything packs into one bag.

name: 6ft folding table
description: Six-foot folding table with a wipe-clean top and folding legs. Seats six to eight for a buffet table, a market stall or a card game. The catch on one leg is stiff but it locks safely.

name: Folding chairs, set of 6
description: Six folding chairs with padded seats and a carry strap. Sturdy enough for a garden party and light enough to stack in a shed. The fabric is clean and all hinges are tight.

name: 3x3m pop-up gazebo
description: Pop-up gazebo with a 3x3m canopy, four side panels and leg weights. Sets up in five minutes with two people. Gives shade or rain cover for a garden party or a stall. The bag has a small tear.

name: Disco ball and light
description: Mirror disco ball with a motor and a colour-changing LED pin spot. Fills a room with moving dots. The motor is quiet and the ball is undamaged. Includes a mounting bracket for a ceiling or stand.

name: Chafing dish set, 3 pans
description: Three stainless chafing dishes with lids, water pans and fuel holders. Keeps food warm for hours at a buffet or a party. All pieces are clean and the lids fit well. Fuel canisters not included.

name: Warm-white string lights, 20m
description: Twenty metres of warm-white festoon lights on a black cable, with ten spare bulbs and clips. Indoor or outdoor use. Made a garden party feel like a wedding. The bulbs are all working.
